title: Cold rebuild: mask email addresses
summary: Rebuild MaskLocalParts from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **MaskLocalParts** in *Replacement syntax*: a `Regex.Replace` whose replacement is computed by a
lambda. Now write it again from an **empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution. The tests are the ones
Masking data before it leaves your system is a task you will meet for real, usually under time pressure
during an incident. Being able to write it without looking anything up is the point.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Warm up. What does this print?
steps.explain: The lambda sees each match and writes one `#` per digit. A fixed replacement string writes one `#` per match, whatever its length.

steps.title: Rebuild MaskLocalParts cold
prompt: Write `string MaskLocalParts(string text)`: in every email address, keep the first character of the local part
(before `@`) and replace the rest of it with one `*` per character. `mail ann.lee@contoso.com now` becomes
`mail a******@contoso.com now`. The local part is made of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ % + -`.
Use `Regex.Replace` with a lambda (a `MatchEvaluator`) that computes each replacement.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
